answer: The gate is conveyancer licence: a licence the conveyancing body renews after completed transactions. One fake record is cheap, but 464 aliases need 464 independent authority-backed records, and the registry check behind each is the price the farm pays. Every epoch the issuer confirms the record is still valid, and a forged or lapsed entry is struck off at once. The voyage check runs in the open: 464 fakes pay the full price 464 times, one honest agent pays once, and the anchor trail in the ledger makes the basalt cost visible to everyone.
